d:
Theatre and screen actor Subhash Ahirwar from Madhya Pradesh has appealed to comedian Samay Raina to release his winning episode of India's Got Latent. Ahirwar claims he travelled to perform on the show and won his episode, but it remains unreleased. Meanwhile, Samay Raina's show is facing fresh controversy over a performance featuring the character Salma Deewani. Here's what happened.
